name: HearthBoard
tagline: The friendly command center for the community you actually manage.
positioning: HearthBoard gives small HOA management shops one warm, organized place to run dues, violations, board packets, and homeowner requests.

hero.h1: Run every HOA like it's your only one.
hero.sub: HearthBoard pulls dues, violation letters, board packets, and homeowner tickets into a single cheerful dashboard — so your two-person shop can manage forty communities without dropping a single one.

features.title: Dues that collect themselves
features.description: Auto-invoice every homeowner, chase late payments with gentle reminders, and reconcile to your operating account without exporting a single spreadsheet.

features.title: Violation letters in two clicks
features.description: Snap a photo, pick the covenant, and HearthBoard drafts the compliant notice with photo, deadline, and mailing log attached.

features.title: Board packets, ready Friday
features.description: Financials, open violations, and ARC requests auto-assemble into a clean PDF your board members can actually read on their phones.

features.title: A homeowner portal they'll use
features.description: Residents pay dues, submit ARC requests, and check the pool schedule from one link — cutting your inbound calls by half.

features.title: Reserve tracking that sleeps well
features.description: Model your reserve fund against the study, flag underfunded line items, and show the board exactly where the roof money went.

features.title: Architectural reviews on a timer
features.description: Route paint and fence requests to the ARC, track the response clock, and never blow a state-mandated approval window again.

testimonials.quote: I was managing 22 associations out of a shared inbox and a wall of sticky notes. HearthBoard gave me back my Sundays — the board packets that used to take a full day now build themselves.
testimonials.name: Danielle Prewitt

testimonials.quote: The violation workflow alone paid for us. Photo, covenant, letter, mailed log — all timestamped when a homeowner disputes it. Our attorney actually complimented the records.
testimonials.name: Marcus Elder

testimonials.quote: Homeowners stopped calling to ask if their dues went through. The portal answers it. We added two new communities this quarter without hiring anyone.
testimonials.name: Renata Ochoa

pricing.blurb: For the owner-operator running a handful of associations single-handed.
For the growing shop with a manager, a bookkeeper, and real volume.
For established management firms with dedicated onboarding needs.

homepage.footerBlurb: HearthBoard helps small HOA management shops run more communities with fewer late nights. Built by people who've sat through the board meetings.
